class.name: FellowAcoustics3D
class.brief_description: The scene's 3D sounds heard through its geometry: occluded by walls, with the reverb of the listener's room (FellowEngine).
class.description: Every [AudioStreamPlayer3D] in the tree (but those in the group [code]fellow_no_acoustics[/code]) is heard through what lies between it and the listener (the viewport's [AudioListener3D] or camera, or [member listener_path]). Each physics frame, rays from the listener to playing sources within [member max_distance] — to the source and to points [member source_radius] around it across the line, so that a path past an edge counts — give the share of its paths blocked by the physics world ([member collision_mask]); the bodies the listener and the source are in do not block them. A collider with the metadata [code]fellow_occlusion[/code] (a float, 0 to 1) blocks a path that much (glass 0.3; without it, 1: milestone 90); up to three colliders on a path add up (milestone 91); [code]fellow_occlusion_highs[/code] blocks its highs apart from its level (a curtain: 0.1 and 0.8; milestone 92). That share lowers the direct sound (up to [member occluded_volume_db]) and cuts its highs (a high shelf of up to [member occluded_shelf_db] above a cutoff moving down to [member occluded_cutoff_hz]), eased over [member response_time]. [member max_rays_per_frame] bounds the rays: with many sources each is tested in turn. With [member reverb] on, rays from the listener in every direction ([member reverb_rays], every [member reverb_interval]) measure its room: how much of what is above and around it is closed (the enclosure), how far the walls are. A reverb on the bus [member reverb_bus] (made, sending to Master, if there is none; an [AudioEffectReverb] added to it if it has none) takes its decay from the room's size and [member absorption] (Sabine's formula), its predelay from the nearest wall; every source is sent to it, more in a closed room ([member reverb_level] at full enclosure) and less cut by occlusion than its direct sound. What the node made it removes when it leaves the tree. With [member source_rooms] a source in another room is sent to a reverb of its own room's instead (decision 0218). Openings (milestone 99): a source the rays find blocked is heard through the nearest open [FellowAcousticPortal3D] between it and the listener when both legs of the path through it are clear and it is louder that way — from the opening's direction at the path's length (the player's own distance attenuation), its level lowered by the bend through the opening ([member portal_diffraction_db] a quarter turn) and the portal's [member FellowAcousticPortal3D.transmission], its highs by the bend (a full turn: as through a wall). Where it is heard from moves there and back with [member response_time]. The sounds' gains, shelves and sends are set through a hook in [AudioStreamPlayer3D] (its own properties are left as they are); without the node, or with it disabled, the players are stock's. One works at a time: the last to enter the tree. Works with GodotPhysics3D and Jolt. See decision 0186 in FellowEngine's [code]docs/decisions[/code].

method.name: get_global_stats
method.description: Returns the node's totals since the start or [method reset_global_stats]: [code]frames[/code], [code]usec[/code] (its time on the CPU), [code]rays[/code] and [code]tests[/code] (sources tested).

method.name: get_heard_position
method.description: Where the player is heard from (milestone 99): its own position, or towards the path through an opening by [method get_portal_weight] — the opening's direction from the listener at the path's length.

method.name: get_occlusion
method.description: Returns the share of [param player]'s paths to the listener that are blocked, eased ([code]0[/code] open to [code]1[/code] blocked); [code]0[/code] for a player the node does not track.

method.name: get_occlusion_highs
method.description: The share of [param player]'s paths blocked for its highs (the shelf and the cutoff), 0 to 1, eased: as [method get_occlusion] unless the colliders on them have [code]fellow_occlusion_highs[/code] (milestone 92).

method.name: get_portal_weight
method.description: How much the player is heard through an opening (milestone 99): 0 not, 1 fully (smoothed over [member response_time]).

method.name: get_room
method.description: Returns the listener's room as measured: [code]enclosure[/code] (0 open to 1 closed), [code]mean_distance[/code] and [code]nearest[/code] (metres to the walls found), [code]rt60[/code] (the decay, seconds), the reverb's [code]room_size[/code] and [code]predelay_msec[/code], and the [code]send[/code] of the sources to it.

method.name: get_source_room
method.description: The room [param player]'s source is in, as rays from it measure it ([member source_rooms]): [code]measured[/code], [code]enclosure[/code], [code]mean_distance[/code], [code]nearest[/code], [code]rt60[/code] (its decay), and the reverb it is sent to — [code]bus[/code], [code]bus_rt60[/code], [code]bus_room_size[/code] — and [code]send[/code] (the share of it sent).

method.name: get_stats
method.description: Returns the last frame's [code]sources[/code] (tracked), [code]audible[/code], [code]occluded[/code] (more than half blocked), [code]rays[/code], [code]tests[/code], [code]usec[/code], and [code]active[/code] (this node is the one working).

members.member: How much of the sound the room's surfaces absorb (the mean absorption coefficient): with the room's size it sets the reverb's decay.
The physics layers that block sound and make rooms.
If [code]false[/code], the sounds are stock's (the node's settings on them reset).
The node the sounds are heard from; empty: the viewport's [AudioListener3D], or its camera.
Sources farther from the listener than this (or than their own [member AudioStreamPlayer3D.max_distance]) are not tested.
The openings tried for a blocked source (nearest path first, two rays each), at most.
The occlusion's rays a physics frame at most: with more sources than they cover, each is tested in turn.
The high shelf's cutoff for a fully blocked source (from the player's [member AudioStreamPlayer3D.attenuation_filter_cutoff_hz] when open).
The high shelf's gain for a fully blocked source.
The direct sound's gain for a fully blocked source.
The rays to each source: one to it and the rest to points [member source_radius] around it.
The level a path through an opening loses for bending a quarter turn there (in proportion to the bend).
Whether blocked sources are heard through [FellowAcousticPortal3D]s (milestone 99).
How fast a source's occlusion follows what the rays find (the time constant, seconds).
If [code]true[/code], the listener's room is measured and every source is sent to its reverb.
The bus the reverb is on: made when there is none (sending to Master), its first [AudioEffectReverb] driven (one added when it has none).
Seconds between the room's measurements.
The sources' send to the reverb in a fully closed room.
How far the room's rays reach (metres).
The rays measuring the room, spread over every direction.
How fast the reverb follows the room as the listener moves (the time constant, seconds).
How far around a source its other rays aim (metres): a path past an edge within it counts.

How many reverbs there are for rooms other than the listener's (buses named [member reverb_bus] + "Room1", "Room2"..., made like [member reverb_bus]'s and removed with it). With them each audible source's own room is measured in turn (one a frame, [member reverb_rays] rays from it, within [member max_rays_per_frame]): a source in a room of its own — closed over by at least half, and unlike the listener's (more than 0.2 apart in enclosure or its mean distance more than 1.5 times the other) — is sent to a room reverb instead of the listener's: the one already holding an alike room, else a free one, else the one whose room is nearest. Each is driven by the mean of its sources' rooms as the listener's reverb is by the listener's (decay, predelay, damping; eased over [member reverb_response]), and a source is sent to it by how closed its own room is, cut by half its occlusion's decibels. A hall heard from the street through its doors keeps its echo; a closet next door sounds small. 0: every source sent to the listener's reverb (as before milestone 111).
